request.spec:
Show on each person their settled-total (the due of their SETTLED claims that count, at
their frozen figures, corrections included) and their open-total (the due of their OPEN and
PENDING claims that count: a held, deferred or retired-and-excluded claim is left out as it is
from the due-total). Show the sheet's settled-total and open-total too, each simply everyone's
figure added up (not trimmed). The two must add up to the person's untrimmed due-total before the
cap.
request.prompt:
You are implementing ONE change to this application.

FIRST read AGENTS.md — it states the working rules and how the app is tested, and sends you to
DESIGN.md for the app's stack and conventions. Follow both.

THE CHANGE REQUEST:
Show on each person their settled-total (the due of their SETTLED claims that count, at
their frozen figures, corrections included) and their open-total (the due of their OPEN and
PENDING claims that count: a held, deferred or retired-and-excluded claim is left out as it is
from the due-total). Show the sheet's settled-total and open-total too, each simply everyone's
figure added up (not trimmed). The two must add up to the person's untrimmed due-total before the
cap.

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.
Read that spec: it declares the exact data-testid anchors, values, test data and any audit
records it expects — match them. Run `bin/e2e` to build the app, start it, and run the test as
you work; iterate until it passes. Change whatever the request needs across the app — its stored
data, its server and its front end. Do NOT edit bin/build, bin/start, bin/stop, bin/e2e,
AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, DESIGN.md, e2e/support/ or the test spec.

agent.result_text:
I added each person's settled-total and open-total, plus the sheet's two totals. All 4 acceptance tests pass.

The first `bin/e2e` run failed because another process was using port 3000 when the app tried to start. Port 3000 was free again when I checked, so I re-ran on another port with `PORT=3047 bin/e2e`.

The change is all in the front end, in `src/main/frontend/src/app/features/people/people.ts`. No database or server changes were needed.

- **Per person:** two new columns sit next to Due:
  - `person-settled-total` adds up their SETTLED claims at their frozen figures.
  - `person-open-total` adds up their OPEN and PENDING claims.
- **Which claims count:** both use the same rule the due-total already uses. So held, deferred and retired-and-excluded claims are left out, and a correction counts under its own status. That keeps settled + open equal to the person's due-total before the cap.
- **Sheet totals:** `rollup-settled-total` and `rollup-open-total` are everyone's figures simply added up, without the trimming the due-total uses.

If a claim's due shows as "n/a" (no rate applies), it is skipped in both totals, so a person with none shows 0.00. The due-total itself can still read "n/a" in that case. The test doesn't cover this situation.
